footer.tagline: A modern MDX-powered platform for blogs and documentation.

home.heroSubtitle: A modern MDX-powered platform for blogs and documentation.
home.heroTagline: Write content in Markdown, ship with React.
home.heroDescription: MDXHub is a blazingly fast blog and documentation platform. Write in Markdown, embed React components, and deploy anywhere.
home.sectionFeatures: Everything you need to ship content
home.sectionFeaturesDesc: MDXHub combines the simplicity of Markdown with the power of React — no compromises.
home.featureLightningDesc: Built on Vite 8 with instant HMR, sub-second page loads, and automatic code splitting. Your dev experience will never be the same.
home.featureMdxDesc: Write content in Markdown with embedded React components. No build step, no config — just drop in interactive content.
home.featureTypeSafeDesc: Full TypeScript 6 support with strict type checking. Catch errors at compile time, not runtime. Ship with confidence.
home.featureInteractiveDesc: Live code sandboxes, diagrams, tabs, accordions, tooltips — all available in your Markdown. Your readers can edit and run code.
home.featureSeoDesc: JSON-LD structured data, Open Graph tags, auto-generated sitemap, RSS feed, and canonical URLs — search engines will love your content.
home.featureOpenSourceDesc: MIT licensed. Self-host on Vercel, Netlify, or any static host. Full control over your content and data — no vendor lock-in.
home.sectionLiveDemoDesc: See our MDX components in action
home.sectionWhatIsDesc: MDXHub is an open-source blog and documentation platform that lets you write content in Markdown and use React components inline. It's built with React 19, Vite 8, and Tailwind CSS 4, and features interactive components like live code sandboxes, diagrams, tabs, and accordions — all usable directly in your Markdown files.
home.sectionGetStartedDesc: Start writing in Markdown, embed React components, and deploy anywhere. No database required.

blog.newsletterDesc: Get the latest posts delivered straight to your inbox. No spam, ever. Unsubscribe anytime.
blog.checkInbox: Check your inbox to confirm your subscription.
blog.sponsorDesc: If you find our content and tools helpful, consider becoming a sponsor. Your support helps us keep building open-source projects!
